name: Berlin
summary: A white field with red stripes at top and bottom and a black bear in the centre. The bear has represented Berlin since the 13th century.
origin: The bear appears on Berlin seals from 1280, probably as a pun on the city's name. The flag was adopted by West Berlin in 1954 and extended to all of Berlin after reunification in 1990.

symbols.name: Berlin bear
symbols.description: A black bear standing upright with its tongue out.
symbols.meaning: The city, through a pun on 'Bär' (bear) and 'Berlin'.

facts: Painted 'Buddy Bear' statues decorate the city.
East Berlin used a different flag until 1990.
Berlin is both a city and a federal state.
clues: A black bear on white between two red stripes.
Its animal is a pun on the city's name.
The flag of a city-state that was divided until 1990.
